card.text: HIP 116454 b was found in 2014 by K2 as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HIP 116454 b"
sources.quote: HIP 116454 b, or K2-2 b, is an exoplanet orbiting the star HIP 116454, 62 parsecs (201 ly) from Earth toward the constellation Pisces.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HIP 116454. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HIP 116454 b"
sources.quote: It is 32,000 kilometres (20,000 mi) in diameter and 12 times as massive as Earth.

shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
